esp32_usb_camera_init.message0: USB camera initialize resolution %1 frame rate %2 VBUS control pin %3 active level %4
esp32_usb_camera_init.tooltip: Requires ESP32-S3 and Arduino-ESP32 3.3.12. Connect a Full-Speed MJPEG camera: GPIO19=D−, GPIO20=D+. The VBUS pin controls an external 5V power switch; -1 means continuous external power. Initialization returns asynchronously; check connection status and error code.

esp32_usb_camera_is_connected.tooltip: True after MJPEG negotiation succeeds and video streaming starts.

esp32_usb_camera_capture.message0: USB camera capture new frame wait %1 ms
esp32_usb_camera_capture.tooltip: Wait for a new JPEG and keep a stable snapshot; returns true on success. Timeout: 0–60000 ms. Zero reads only a new frame not yet captured. Failure clears the old snapshot.

esp32_usb_camera_frame_info.tooltip: Width, height and byte size describe the captured snapshot; zero when none exists. Frame count includes video frames received since initialization.

esp32_usb_camera_release.tooltip: Invalidate the current snapshot. Capture again before saving. Background USB streaming continues.

esp32_usb_camera_last_error.tooltip: Zero means ESP_OK; other values are ESP-IDF error codes. Also reports asynchronous connection, memory and format errors.

esp32_usb_camera_save.message0: USB camera save current JPEG to %1 path %2
esp32_usb_camera_save.tooltip: Save the captured snapshot and return true on success. Mount storage with its filesystem library before capturing. An existing file at the same path is overwritten.

esp32_usb_camera_server_start.message0: USB camera start web preview port %1
esp32_usb_camera_server_start.tooltip: Connect WiFi first. The background HTTP server provides web preview and the /capture JPEG endpoint. Valid ports: 1–65535; invalid values use 80.

esp32_usb_camera_server_url.tooltip: Return the WiFi LAN preview URL with the actual port, or an empty string if the HTTP server is stopped.

esp32_usb_camera_server_stop.tooltip: Stop the HTTP server. USB camera streaming continues.

esp32_usb_camera_end.message0: USB camera stop and release resources
esp32_usb_camera_end.tooltip: Stop HTTP and the camera; release USB resources owned by this library. If stopping fails, retain resources still in use. Check the last error and retry.
